TaskDescription: Sentence reading (RSVP, 2 words/sec, 200 ms word duration + 300 ms blank). Subjects read sentences word-by-word while EEG was recorded. The main experiment (80 items) tested whether readers pre-activate upcoming words by examining N400-like responses to indefinite articles ('a' vs 'an') that precede expected or unexpected nouns.
Instructions: Read the sentences as they appear on screen and answer yes/no comprehension questions when they occur by pressing the button.
InstitutionAddress: Beacon House, Queens Road, Bristol BS8 1QU, United Kingdom
